verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own AskFred assistant documents natural-language questions across multiple meetings, with conversational follow-ups that keep context, so the core of the story is first-party. The evidence never shows answers coming back with source citations or links to transcript moments, and it does not explicitly say the search spans the whole meeting history. Missing for 10: documented source citations/attribution in answers, explicit whole-history scope, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: AskFred is Fireflies' AI-powered meeting assistant that lets you ask natural language questions about your meeting transcripts.
Query individual meetings or search across multiple meetings to get intelligent, context-aware answers.
Maintain conversations where follow-up questions preserve context from previous exchanges
